description:
Let the product's repository initialisation run over any repository-state store, so in-memory repositories can be initialised by the same code as file-backed ones.

## Background

`initialize_fresh_repository` and `run_initialization` exist only on `impl CommandExecutor<JsonFileStorage>` (`crates/jit/src/commands/init.rs:73-215`), although both go through the generic `with_mutation_session`. `repository_state::initialize::structural_minimum_config` is the pure minimal configuration. Test support therefore seeds memory stores by hand.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Product initialisation is available on `CommandExecutor<S>` for every store implementing the repository-state store trait, and the JSON backend's behaviour is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: A unit test initialises an in-memory store and observes the same configuration, index and data-root files the JSON backend writes.
title: Product initialisation runs over any repository-state store
